description: This file manages the run history for a web application, including functions to list, add, clear, and export run records stored in localStorage. It defines data types for run records and provides utility functions for JSON parsing, CSV exporting, and ID generation.

methods.name: listRunHistory
methods.description: Returns run history in reverse chronological order, limited to a specified number.

methods.name: addRunRecord
methods.description: Adds a new run record to persisted local history, generating a unique ID and timestamp.

methods.name: clearRunHistory
methods.description: Clears all persisted run history records from localStorage.

methods.name: exportRunHistoryJson
methods.description: Exports the run history as a pretty-printed JSON string.

methods.name: exportRunHistoryCsv
methods.description: Exports the run history as a CSV string suitable for spreadsheet import.
